g.text: This is an OpenDID OID4VCI extension API that does not use an Access Token or the TAS.
The wallet uses the credential_revocation_endpoint and nonce_endpoint of the Issuer Metadata.
The revocation target is identified by the Status List reference (status_list{uri, idx}) contained in the SD-JWT VC or mdoc.
payload = { iss: Holder DID, iat, exp (within 5 minutes after iat),
c_nonce consumption and the status change are processed in a single transaction,
and if the status change fails, the c_nonce consumption is also rolled back.
SSRVISS00206 : Issued Credential does not exist or is not in ISSUED status
SSRVISS00210 : c_nonce does not exist, has expired, or has been reused
SSRVISS00302 : Token format / Claim / validity period error, Holder mismatch
SSRVISS00413 : Signature verification or public key decoding failed
The revocation is reflected in the Status List, and a verifier checks whether the Credential
is revoked with the Status List reference in the Credential when the Credential is presented.
header = { alg: "ES256", typ: "statuslist+jwt", kid: Issuer DID URL }
payload = { sub: status_list uri, iat, exp, ttl,
